title: Ставка в подпольном казино  (A Bet in the Underground Casino)

segments.t: Max arrives at the address in Butovo and discovers an underground casino. Chef Barinov has lost all his money at the table, and when Max has almost no cash on him, the Chef puts Max himself up as the stake.
А здесь у вас казино находится?
У тебя с собой деньги есть?
Шеф, вы же ничего не говорили.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
А здесь у вас казино находится?
'Is there a casino located in here?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'is located'.
'Barinov is here, he called for me.' The grammar packs 'here' and 'invited' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Alright, then come in here quickly.' the guest anchors the line on 'all right', while 'faster' completes the thought. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'Maximka, you have finally arrived!' An emphatic spoken line centered on the verb meaning 'came'.
У тебя с собой деньги есть?
'Do you have any money with you?' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'at' and 'you' in a few short words.
Шеф, вы же ничего не говорили.
'Chef, you did not say anything about money.' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'spoke' to negate the statement. Chef Barinov answers right away.
'Well, you could have guessed it yourself.' Chef Barinov brings out the contrast between 'come on' and 'yourself' in a few short words.
'Vitya, are you going to keep playing?' Notice how Russian expresses 'Vitya' and 'will' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Yes, I will, I am betting him.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'am betting'. Max answers right away.
'Chef, what on earth are you doing?' Notice how Russian expresses 'Chef Barinov' and 'are doing' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Be quiet, he is a good, hardworking guy.' Chef Barinov anchors the line on 'be silent', while 'guy' completes the thought.

'Well alright, let us keep playing.' The grammar packs 'come on' and 'further' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
А здесь у вас казино находится?
У тебя с собой деньги есть?
Шеф, вы же ничего не говорили.
Max watches in horror as his own freedom is wagered on a casino table at dawn. Fortunately, beginner's luck is about to save them both. Until next time!
